reason: The bound Proposition 15.7 includes connected nonempty zero-dimensional Riemannian manifolds, but the selected Lean declaration requires NeZero (Module.finrank ℝ E). The identity of a one-point Riemannian manifold has a complete connected source and is a local isometry and a surjective Riemannian covering, yet its zero-dimensional tangent model cannot satisfy this extra hypothesis. The formal theorem therefore covers only the positive-dimensional part of the unrestricted bound target. The corrected connected-source convention is accepted and is not the mismatch.

distance_scope_check.argument: Between different path components there is no path, so the intrinsic extended distance is infinity. In a MetricSpace every ambient edist is finite. Thus a nonempty source satisfying MetricSpace and IsRiemannianDist is already path connected, even if the explicit ConnectedSpace parameter is removed.
distance_scope_check.consequence: The corrected target uses a connected source and the induced Riemannian distance. The finite-distance compatibility condition is appropriate to that target and is not used as misalignment evidence.
